page.layout: One page of a table in four columns: at left the names of the fractions (Quincunx, Triens, Quadrans, Sextans, Uncia) with a column of numbers beside them; a centre column of scruple values under the heading "Scrupula"; a right-hand column headed "Notae communes" with fraction notation; a single line at the foot. A digitiser's link at the bottom is not transcribed.
page.notes: The fraction notation in the right column is set as stacked numerals with rules; the figures are copied as they stand, with the bar shown as a slash. The numerals of the right column read: 5/12, 2/5, 5/11, 3/0 (for 30), 1/3, 3/10, 4/15, 1/4, 7/30, 1/5, 1/6, 2/15, 1/11, 1/12, and the last line "H 4 4" at the foot. The "Triens" entry shows "30" written as 3 with a superscript o; the "Notae communes" heading is a column heading. The tail line reads H, 4, 4. Some of the printed figures are damaged and may be misread.
